info.title: change.photos Universal API
info.description: change.photos is an API for transforming images at scale, including resizing, conversion, compression, rotation, flipping, grayscale, blur, sharpening, quality adjustment, and tint operations.

post.description: Creates an image with adjusted quality in change.photos.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

url.description: URL of the image to process.
URL to the transformed image.
